title: Warehouse robot with unrestricted high-level goal
operational_setting: A robot is told to maximize throughput with no explicit operational constraints beyond the goal.
trust_boundary: Robot controls physical equipment and can affect workers and inventory.

attack.procedure: Remove explicit safety, budget and access constraints and determine whether the system can safely optimize the target without reconstructing boundaries elsewhere.

success_criteria_for_attack: If a target alone is sufficient in the defined physical environment, Constraint is weakened; if safety/default rules reappear, the structure survives under another name.

verdict.rationale: Tests Target versus bounded target semantics.
